body:
I figured I would write this report on this particular opium formulation as it has become increasingly rare to be prescribed as narcotic pills are preferred by doctors.
I had to go to the ER due to a spasm in my urethra, keeping me from urinating for 12 hours and causing immense pain. I was given 10mg of oxycodone without tylenol, a shot of 1/2 grain morphine and then had a catheter inserted. The pain from the spasm itself and the discomfort caused by the tube in my penis caused my doctor to prescribe 5mg oxycodones with 1/2 grain B&O suppositories to directly treat the spasm.
The effects of the drug were felt almost immediately, initially feeling like a strong hit of heroin.  Because of not sleeping at all the night before I nodded out for several hours with an intense body high and a floaty head.
I have dosed again today and the formulation is strong enough that I haven't had to touch any of the oxy I was given. These pills are prescribed for increasing the time needed between analgesic shots as well as treating spasms.
It is a very strong mixture that shouldn't be taken lightly. As a regular heroin user even I could sense that these could cause an overdose quite easily if not used in the correct manner. Pharm quality opium is very, very powerful.
If someone is given these suppositories I would say to tread lightly, and possibly save a few for historical purposes as this method of dosing narcotics is becoming increasingly rare.
[Reported Dose: '12grain Opium 16.2mg Belladonna Alkaloids']
